kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أرتكب (form VIII)
# أَرْتَكِبُ (ʔartakibu) /ʔar.ta.ki.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَكَبَ (irtakaba)
# أُرْتَكَبُ (ʔurtakabu) /ʔur.ta.ka.bu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَكَبَ (irtakaba)
# أَرْتَكِبَ (ʔartakiba) /ʔar.ta.ki.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَكَبَ (irtakaba)
# أُرْتَكَبَ (ʔurtakaba) /ʔur.ta.ka
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
